_provenance.notes: Kodiak, Alaska consistently ranks as one of the top 3 US fishing ports by ex-vessel value, routinely exceeding $150M annually. The Kodiak fishing economy is diversified across groundfish (cod, pollock, rockfish), salmon (pink, sockeye, Chinook), crab (king, tanner, Dungeness), shrimp, and halibut. The port has 12+ active processing plants and a fleet of over 800 registered fishing vessels. Kodiak was devastated by the 1964 Good Friday Earthquake and tsunami (9.2 magnitude) which destroyed the fishing fleet and waterfront.
